review.note: 2026-10-31 release 0.10.5 dependency review. Runtime declarations, Python >=3.14 and all bounds are unchanged. This release repairs Windows tracked-path identity and fixture generation cleanup, makes CSV/cache fixtures portable, and gates PyPI publication on the same candidate's native Windows checks. Latest official registry versions were reviewed against the previous 0.10.4 receipt: hatchling 1.33.0, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.1, pytest 9.2.0, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, Ruff 0.17.3 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0. All are admitted by the existing bounds; no out-of-bound stable version was found. Reused the explicitly attributed 2026-10-30 official notes for unchanged versions: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ (Python 3.15 support), https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib (launcher and archive containment fixes), https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html (metadata 2.6/VersionRange), https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html (Windows symlink probe correction), https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html (2.4.1 two-phase overload/nested function fixes), https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html (loadscope ordering), https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.3 (f-string/formatting fixes), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md (dependency updates, Node >=22). Re-read pytest 9.2.0 official notes at https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html and inspected the installed assertion cache implementation: checked source hashes replace timestamp-size headers. The negative-control fixture now prepares a valid candidate header with deliberately stale code so it really proves cache isolation; it passes on both pytest 9.1.1 and 9.2.0 rather than excluding the new release. Inspected installed distlib 0.4.4 ScriptMaker source: its failed file-copy writer keeps an input handle alive in traceback; in-memory template generation removes that path without implementing a new PE launcher or changing public fixture bytes. Native Windows confirmation is still required. Normal uv resolution installed latest permitted Python tools and pip check passed; Node 24 satisfies >=22 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 was installed and exercised. Fast passed with Ruff 0.17.3, strict mypy 2.4.1 and Markdown; targeted author suites passed 162 tests with 3 native-Windows skips on each pytest cohort, and 11 fixture tests/3 skips after test-import cleanup. Every Python latest has eligible non-yanked Python 3.14 artifacts per the generated audit. Distlib omits Requires-Python but declares 3.14 support; pytest-xdist uses >=3.9 without a specific 3.14 classifier. Metadata eligibility, local tests and final platform/review/full-gate evidence are separate; no native Windows pass or publication of 0.10.5 is claimed here.
